 Vikings Elevate Jeshaun Jones & Devin Culp for Week 10 at Packers
 Nov 14, 2026 at 03:30 PM Craig Peters Editing Director & Quality Control
 Copied! 
 EAGAN, Minn. — The Vikings (6-2) on Saturday announced the elevations of receiver Jeshaun Jones and tight end Devin Culp ahead of visiting the Packers (6-3) at noon (CT) Sunday in Week 10.
 Jones is poised for his third appearance in a game this season. He logged 11 special teams snaps against the Dolphins in Week 4 and followed with 11 more for the third phase in Week 5 at New Orleans. Jones recorded his first career reception for a gain of 32 against the Saints.
 Vikings receiver Jauan Jennings was ruled out Friday because of a calf injury, and Jordan Addison was added to Minnesota's injury report Friday and listed as questionable because of a thumb injury, so Jones can add reinforcements to the receivers room.
 Culp joined Minnesota's practice squad in late October.
 A seventh-round pick of Tampa Bay in 2024, Culp totaled six receptions for 94 yards and a touchdown on seven targets over the course of 18 games from 2024-25.
 Culp's elevation occurred after T.J. Hockenson was ruled out Friday because of chest and wrist injuries. He will join Vikings tight ends Gavin Bartholomew and Ben Yurosek.
